findings.summary: Theme ignores the system color-scheme preference
findings.evidence: Light and dark emulation produced identical dark colors and color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and initialise the selected theme from prefers-color-scheme while preserving an explicit user override.

findings.summary: Persistent sign-up strip obscures gallery content
findings.evidence: The first-load gallery screenshot shows a full-width fixed sign-up strip covering the bottom of artwork with no dismiss control.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the prompt dismissible and non-blocking, reserve layout space, or defer it until intent is shown.

findings.summary: User menu uses a custom unnamed dialog container
findings.evidence: The DOM has a div role=dialog with no accessible name and no dialog/popover/details primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the native popover/menu pattern for transient user navigation with declarative light-dismiss and an accessible name.

findings.summary: Narrow screens receive a scaled desktop layout
findings.evidence: Layout probes found no viewport meta and used a 1024px CSS viewport, scaling the desktop gallery into 360/780px captures.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid width=device-width, initial-scale=1 viewport and reflow the gallery/navigation with intrinsic responsive layout.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible on several controls
findings.evidence: The focus walk found user-menu buttons/links with outline:none and no replacement shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and ensure hidden menu controls cannot receive focus.

findings.summary: Core public routes fail with an unrecoverable edge error
findings.evidence: Tag, artwork, profile, and shop attempts returned generic CloudFront 403 pages without navigation or recovery actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix edge/WAF routing for legitimate browser traffic and serve a branded retry/back state for transient failures.

findings.summary: Mobile Core Web Vitals are poor
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 14.5s, CLS 0.641, TBT 200ms, and a 0.40 performance score.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile LCP discovery, prioritise the hero artwork, reserve all feed geometry, and break up long tasks.

findings.summary: The feed shifts substantially during load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.641.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image/card/banner dimensions and stabilise font and conditional-prompt space before paint.

findings.summary: Long main-thread tasks delay responsiveness
findings.evidence: The trace recorded three long tasks, longest 219ms, with 221ms total blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Chunk, defer, or priority-schedule non-critical JavaScript and move suitable work off the main thread.

findings.summary: Initial resource delivery is heavy
findings.evidence: The home load transferred 2.49MB over 89 requests, including a 420KB JS bundle and render-blocking stylesheet.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the critical chain, split/defer non-critical bundles, and explicitly prioritise the LCP artwork.

findings.summary: Large JavaScript dominates the first load
findings.evidence: Seven scripts transferred 748KB; the largest was about 420KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage to remove unused modules, split route-only code, and load optional features on demand.

findings.summary: Hidden controls remain exposed to assistive technology
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found focusable descendants inside aria-hidden content and a visible-label/accessibility-name mismatch.
findings.suggestedFix: When the menu is closed, use inert or remove controls from focus order; align accessible names with visible labels.

findings.summary: Focus management breaks in the hidden user menu
findings.evidence: Focusable aria-hidden descendants and outline:none controls make keyboard state ambiguous.
findings.suggestedFix: Use inert for closed UI, restore trigger focus on close, and provide visible :focus-visible styling.

findings.summary: Mobile reflow relies on page scaling
findings.evidence: The narrow probe used a 1024px CSS layout and no viewport meta, shrinking rather than reflowing text and controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a valid responsive viewport and verify 320px/400% zoom reflow without two-dimensional scrolling.

findings.summary: Production JavaScript source maps are unavailable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found one large script without a map and multiple map URLs returning 403.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish valid protected production source maps to the error-monitoring/debug pipeline or remove broken references.

findings.summary: Mobile/search crawl signals are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found a generic “Learn more” link and runtime layout probes found no viewport meta.
findings.suggestedFix: Use destination-specific link text and consistently emit the viewport meta in every response variant.

findings.summary: No sitemap is available at the conventional endpoint
findings.evidence: A direct /sitemap.xml request returned HTTP 404 despite the site hosting a very large public art catalog.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish sitemap indexes for major public archetypes and reference them from robots.txt.

findings.summary: Cookie and CSP hardening is incomplete
findings.evidence: CSP permits unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline and the td/userinfo cookies lacked Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate unsafe-eval, migrate inline execution to nonce/hash coverage, and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with appropriate HttpOnly/SameSite flags.

findings.summary: The initial page has a broad cross-origin footprint
findings.evidence: HAR classified 87 of 89 requests and 2.33MB as cross-origin, including telemetry to frog.wix.com.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory cross-origin requests, remove low-value telemetry, batch analytics, and defer optional services until needed or consented.

findings.summary: Permissions-Policy is absent
findings.evidence: The header primitive found no Permissions-Policy and CSP still allows unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and continue tightening CSP with report-only telemetry before enforcement changes.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit autocomplete tokens
findings.evidence: The username field had no autocomplete value; search explicitly disabled autocomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username on sign-in identity and appropriate current-password/passkey tokens on the next step; avoid disabling useful completion without cause.

findings.summary: Initial background and script work is wasteful
findings.evidence: Before interaction the page transferred 2.49MB and ran three long tasks totalling 221ms blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold feed work, deprioritise background requests, and avoid initialising optional creator/AI features before intent.

findings.summary: Cross-origin script and font budget is high
findings.evidence: Cross-origin delivery totalled 2.33MB, with 748KB of scripts and 113KB of fonts.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an initial-load budget, subset/preload only essential fonts, split optional scripts, and defer lower-value cross-origin work.
